findings.text: The PRD does not say what happens when the owner types R$ 0,00 of spend with new customers above 0 (CAC = 0). I kept the output finite and followed RULE-dm-02 literally: cacCents 0, ratio null (a division by zero is not a number), paybackMonths 0, neverPaysBack false. Consequence: the 'ratio' item of Canal e receita is worth 0 points and the stage 3 gate stops at the lock 'ratio' (action text 'cada cliente deixa menos de 3 vezes o que custou'), which reads wrong for a customer that cost nothing. Needs a product decision (for example, treat a free customer as above the healthy band) before the rules are frozen; covered by a test that documents the current behavior.

BR-dm-15 only names SIG-02 for a R$ 0 margin. A customer that never pays back also satisfies SIG-06 ('Payback > 12 meses'), so detectRisks fires SIG-06 when neverPaysBack is true (the margin R$ 0 case returns SIG-02 and SIG-06). If the owner wants SIG-02 alone, remove the neverPaysBack clause in the SIG-06 check.

The two test files are larger than the 300-line ideal (about 385 and 567 logic lines by a rough count; `aioson rules:check` reports 0 violations). I could not split them because the unit contract allows only these two test files; the evaluate unit's G1-G4 end-to-end tests live in tests/unit/evaluateDiagnosis.test.ts.

`pnpm test -- <files>` does not filter: pnpm passes the `--` to vitest and the whole suite runs (7 files, 395 tests in the final run). My first full run showed 2 failures in tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts (unit phase-1-backend-http, then still implementing: 503 database_unavailable and 403 host_not_allowed with empty Host); the final run of the official command passed with exit code 0. Focused run of only my two files: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/unitEconomics.test.ts tests/unit/diagnosisRules.test.ts` => 201 tests pass.

Four deliberate mutations of the rule modules (ratio <= 5 band edge, measured vs estimated cost gate, payback > 12 edge, half-up rounding) made 12 tests fail; the sources were restored afterwards and the suite is green again.

evidence.result: AC-dm-15, AC-dm-51 (unitEconomics.test.ts: G1-G4 numbers, half-up cents, BR-dm-14, BR-dm-15, no NaN/Infinity). AC-dm-19, AC-dm-21, AC-dm-23, AC-dm-24 (diagnosisRules.test.ts). Also covered at module level: AC-dm-18 scores, AC-dm-20 stage and lock (G1-G4 + edge table including estimated cost blocking stage 3), AC-dm-49 confidence, AC-dm-14 pendingBlocks. The e2e halves of these ACs are left to integration.

messages.text: Module API to compose in evaluateDiagnosis(input, rules): computeUnitEconomics(calculator, rules): UnitEconomics (shared/domain/unitEconomics.ts); computeDimensionScores(answers, unitEconomics, rules): Record<DimensionKey, DimensionResult> and findWeakestDimension(dimensions): DimensionKey (dimensionScores.ts); computeStageAndLock({ answers, dimensions, unitEconomics }, rules): { stage, lock } (stageGate.ts); detectRisks({ answers, dimensions, unitEconomics }, rules): RiskResult[] already sorted and cut to rules.risk.maxRisks (riskSignals.ts); computeConfidence(answers, unitEconomics, rules): ConfidenceResult (confidence.ts). All are pure, never throw and never return NaN/Infinity. Not written here and still yours: the action plan (actionPlan.ts) and evaluateDiagnosis.ts. For the plan: 'invest' is eligible only when unitEconomics.origin === 'measured', confidence.level === 'high' and stage >= rules.plan.invest.minStage (RULE-dm-10); the 'dep' action follows SIG-04 being in the risks list.

UnitEconomics conventions: paybackMonths is null when the customer never pays back (neverPaysBack true), because Infinity would not survive JSON; the origin is 'unknown' when new customers is 0 (BR-dm-14) while newCustomersOrigin stays 'measured'; ratio is computed from the rounded cents (ltvCents / cacCents) and kept exact (9 decimals) for gates and risks; ratio is null when cacCents is 0. Reference tests for G1-G4 end to end (computeUnitEconomics -> scores -> stage -> risks -> confidence) are yours in tests/unit/evaluateDiagnosis.test.ts; my tests feed the same G1-G4 numbers into each module separately and match the PRD table.

pendingBlocks(answers, calculator): BlockNumber[] (shared/domain/completeness.ts) is the completeness check for POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete; a non-empty result is the 422 'incomplete' body's pendingBlocks. Rules: block 1 needs spend (mode exact with at least one cost part typed, an explicit R$ 0,00 counts; or a range; or 'não sei'), new customers (exact integer >= 0, 0 counts; or a range; or 'não sei'), average purchase (integer cents >= 0), purchases per year, relationship length and margin (integer 0..100, 0 counts). Blocks 2 to 8 need every question answered with 0..3, and null ('não sei') counts only for mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1 and co1. Also exported: isBlockComplete(block, answers, calculator) and isCalculatorComplete(calculator) for the block rail.

UnitEconomicsPanel: call computeUnitEconomics(calculator, rulesV1) on every change and read cacCents, ltvCents, ratio, paybackMonths, neverPaysBack and origin. Show formatPayback(economics.neverPaysBack ? 'never' : economics.paybackMonths) and formatRatioWithBand(economics.ratio); mark values 'estimado por faixa' when origin === 'estimated'; when newCustomers === 0 (newCustomersOrigin 'measured', origin 'unknown') show NOT_CALCULATED_LABEL plus NO_NEW_CUSTOMERS_EXPLANATION (BR-dm-14). Call pendingBlocks(...) for the completion gate and the block rail.

Product decision needed before the rules are frozen: a spend of R$ 0,00 with new customers above 0 gives CAC 0 and no ratio (see findings). Also confirm that SIG-06 should fire together with SIG-02 for a R$ 0 margin (BR-dm-15). Neither is covered by the PRD; the current behavior is documented by tests in tests/unit/unitEconomics.test.ts and tests/unit/diagnosisRules.test.ts.
